item.title: Badshah to make history as first Indian rapper to headline The O2, London
item.description: Badshah is set to make history as the first Indian rapper to headline The O2 in London on March 22, 2026. This landmark event marks a significant moment for Indian Hip Hop on the global stage, following his surprise appearance during Diljit Dosanjh’s tour in 2024. Fans can expect a spectacular three-hour performance featuring his greatest hits, enhanced by cutting-edge visuals and international production.
